activities.name: Get Tables List
activities.description: Lookup activity to fetch list of all active tables from IncrementalConfigETL metadata table for incremental processing.

query.value:
@concat('
SELECT
    Id,
    SourceSchemaName,
    SourceTableName,
    BronzeSchemaName,
    BronzeTableName,
    SilverSchemaName,
    SilverTableName,
    LoadType,
    PrimaryKey,
    IsFullLoad,
    IncLoadType,
    SourceDeleteQuery,
    CreatedWaterMarkField,
    CreatedWaterMarkValue,
    UpdatedWaterMarkField,
    UpdatedWaterMarkValue,
    IsActive,
    IsSourceDelete,
    CASE
        WHEN IsFullLoad = 1 THEN
            SourceQuery
        WHEN IncLoadType = 2 THEN
            REPLACE(SourceQuery + '' WHERE CAST('' + CreatedWaterMarkField + '' AS DATE) > CAST('''''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), CreatedWaterMarkValue, 120) + '''''' AS DATE)'', CHAR(13), '''')
        WHEN IncLoadType = 3 THEN
            REPLACE(SourceQuery + '' WHERE CAST('' + UpdatedWaterMarkField + '' AS DATE) > CAST('''''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), UpdatedWaterMarkValue, 120) + '''''' AS DATE)'', CHAR(13), '''')
        WHEN IncLoadType = 4 THEN
            REPLACE(SourceQuery + '' WHERE (CAST('' + CreatedWaterMarkField + '' AS DATE) > CAST('''''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), CreatedWaterMarkValue, 120) + '''''' AS DATE)) OR (CAST('' + UpdatedWaterMarkField + '' AS DATE) > CAST('''''' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), UpdatedWaterMarkValue, 120) + '''''' AS DATE))'', CHAR(13), '''')
        ELSE
            SourceQuery
    END AS SourceQuery
FROM [WH_MetaData].[Config_', pipeline().parameters.SchemaName, '].[IncrementalConfigETL]
WHERE IsActive = 1
ORDER BY Id
')

activities.name: Looping Tables
activities.description: ForEach activity to iterate through each table from the metadata and process them in parallel .

activities.name: Condition To Split Files and Table
activities.description: If Condition to route tables based on LoadType , Table for Lakehouse Table load, otherwise for File (Parquet) load.
